text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Vodka. Chan-me has 
prepared a very wonderful present for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's none other than... a "Ticket to Make 
Memories with Chan-Me for a Whole Day"!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what's with that? Well, I'm glad, 
though. Are you gonna take more photos and 
make another album?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. The memory of a dear friend's 
birthday... It will be Chan-chan's 
treasure.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, maybe I should try 
taking pictures... and make an album of my 
own.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do you want some too, Vodka? Since it's 
your birthday, Machan will—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nah, as long as we're doing it, let's both 
make something and trade when we're done!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Wouldn't that be way more 
interesting? We're probably looking at 
different things anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll look cool, and you can look cute. 
That way, we'll get more photos and 
memories out of it. Sounds pretty good, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm, not bad at all. Somehow, it feels 
as if Machan was the one who received a 
present...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So this is what it means to be "badass."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I don't really get it, but you're 
complimenting me, right? Thanks, Chan-me!
